title: Pregnancy Nutrition: A UK Guide to Eating Safely and Well
excerpt: Most UK women don't get enough folate and vitamin D from diet alone in pregnancy. Here's what to eat, what to avoid, and why.
author: Bite Insight Team
meta_title: Pregnancy Nutrition UK: A Guide to Eating Safely and Well
meta_description: A clear, evidence based UK guide to pregnancy nutrition: the two key supplements, foods to avoid and why, caffeine limits, fish guidance and more.
ai_summary: This guide breaks down UK pregnancy nutrition into what actually matters: folic acid and vitamin D supplementation, a short list of foods to avoid for listeria, toxoplasmosis and mercury risk, and safe caffeine and fish limits. It draws on NHS, RCOG and SACN guidance to separate genuine food safety rules from overcautious myths. The aim is to make pregnancy eating feel manageable rather than restrictive.
